title: GLM-5: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
content: GLM-5 is the successor generation to GLM-4.5 ARC from Zhipu AI, scaling to approximately 744B total parameters with roughly 40B active, trained on 28.5T tokens; the framing shift from 'ARC' to 'agentic engineering' signals intent to sustain coherent goal-directed operation across hundreds of rounds and thousands of tool calls rather than single-session task completion. The architecture introduces DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) and, in GLM-5.2, IndexShare — reusing the same attention index across every four sparse-attention layers to reduce per-token FLOPs by 2.9× at 1M context length — enabling a stable 1M-token context window at production cost. Post-training is powered by SLIME, an asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure that improves sample efficiency for long-horizon agentic task training. GLM-5.1 demonstrates sustained multi-round optimisation with improved handling of ambiguous problem specifications, while GLM-5.2 adds speculative decoding, strengthened terminal and SWE benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1: 81.0; SWE-Bench Pro: 62.1), and deployment on Ascend NPUs alongside vLLM, SGLang, and KTransformers in BF16 and FP8 precision. On Vending Bench 2, a year-long operational simulation, GLM-5 approaches Claude Opus 4.5 performance, validating long-horizon operational coherence.
lesson: GLM-5 instantiates the movement vector that ark's operator layer embodies — from short-horizon code generation toward long-horizon agentic engineering where a single agent sustains goal-directed revision over hundreds of rounds — and its IndexShare sparse attention plus async RL infrastructure demonstrate the engineering requirements for making that coherence practical at scale; ark's operator loop (state → action → feedback → revision) is precisely the behavioural contract GLM-5.1 was post-trained to honour.
key_usages: sustain long-horizon operator loops across hundreds of revision rounds without context collapse
hold the full backtest evidence court (strategies, signals, audit trail) in a 1M-token context window
drive multi-thousand tool-call sequences for automated strategy search and repair
use reasoning_effort=max for deep strategy audits; reasoning_effort=high for faster incremental revisions

key_codes.label: serve GLM-5 via vLLM (FP8)
key_codes.code:
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --tool-call-parser glm47 \
  --reasoning-parser glm45 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --served-model-name glm-5
